what.text: The company operates an integrated service ecosystem that supports passengers throughout their travel journey. It combines Internet Ticketing, Catering, Tourism, and Rail Neer to deliver seamless travel experiences.

segments.name: Internet Ticketing
segments.text: This segment focuses on online ticket booking services for passengers. It has seen an increase in the share of reserved rail tickets booked online.

segments.name: Catering
segments.text: The catering business provides food and hospitality services through trains and railway stations. It includes mobile, static, and e-catering services.

segments.name: Tourism
segments.text: This segment offers travel and tourism services, enhancing the overall travel experience for passengers.

segments.name: Rail Neer
segments.text: Rail Neer is the bottled water segment, ensuring quality drinking water for passengers during their journey.

trajectory.text: Annual revenue grew from ₹4,675 Cr in FY25 to ₹5,215 Cr in FY26.
Net profit increased from ₹1,315 Cr in FY25 to ₹1,393 Cr in FY26.
Quarterly revenue growth was 18.1% year on year in Jun 2026.

verdict.headline: IRCTC shows strong revenue growth but misses some margin targets.

narrative_vs_numbers.text: Management's narrative of sustained growth is supported by an 18.1% year-on-year revenue increase in the latest quarter. However, they missed their operating margin target, achieving 28% instead of the promised 30%.

bull.text: IRCTC achieved a strong 18.1% year-on-year revenue growth in the latest quarter.
The company maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0, indicating strong financial health.
Free cash flow increased significantly to ₹1,196 Cr in FY26, showing improved cash generation.

bear.text: IRCTC missed its target of maintaining a 30% EBITDA margin, achieving only 28% in Jun 2026.
The annual revenue growth of 11.5% in FY26 fell short of the 15% target.
Net profit growth was nearly flat in the latest quarter, with a year-on-year increase of only -0.3%.
